content: # AT&T — Company Overview and Consumer Services ## Company overview AT&T Inc. is a major American telecommunications company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. AT&T provides wireless, broadband, and business communication services across the United States. ## Consumer wireless AT&T offers postpaid and prepaid mobile phone plans for individuals and families. Plans may include unlimited talk, text, and data options, with features such as 5G access on compatible devices. Customers can bring their own device or purchase phones through AT&T with installment or full-payment options. Family plans allow multiple lines on a single account, and per-line pricing typically decreases as more lines are added. Prepaid plans do not require an annual contract or a credit check. ## Home internet AT&T provides home internet services, including fiber (AT&T Fiber) and other broadband options depending on location. Fiber plans advertise high-speed internet suitable for streaming, gaming, and working from home. Availability varies by address; not all services are offered in every area. Customers can check whether service is available at a specific address using the address lookup tool on att.com. Professional installation may be required for new fiber service.

# AT&T — Business Services, Support, and Policies ## Business services AT&T offers business solutions including mobile plans for teams, internet, cloud connectivity, and collaboration tools for small and enterprise customers. Business accounts can add or remove lines as staffing changes. Dedicated internet options are available for businesses that need guaranteed bandwidth. ## Customer support Customers can get help through the AT&T website, the myAT&T app, phone support, and AT&T retail stores. Account holders can manage billing, plan changes, device upgrades, and troubleshooting through online self-service tools. The myAT&T app can be used to view current usage, pay a bill, and check the status of an order. Appointments at AT&T retail stores can be scheduled in advance through att.com. ## Billing and account management Bills are issued monthly and can be paid online, through the myAT&T app, by phone, or in a retail store. AutoPay can be enabled so the balance is charged automatically each billing cycle. Paperless billing is available for customers who prefer electronic statements. ## General policies Service terms, pricing, promotions, and device offers can change and may vary by region. For account-specific details such as an exact bill amount, contract end date, or outage status, customers should be directed to official AT&T channels rather than given a guess. Coverage depends on location, device, and network conditions. If a user asks about AT&T and the answer is not covered in the knowledge base, respond that the information is not available and suggest contacting AT&T support or visiting att.com.
